name: OpenStreetMap-Tile-Server
description: A production-ready OpenStreetMap tile server running inside a single Docker container. Includes PostgreSQL, osm2pgsql, renderd, and Apache. FIRST RUN: Set Post Arguments to and place your .osm.pbf file in the OSM Data path before starting. After import completes, change Post Arguments to [run] and restart. Download map data (PBF files) from https://download.geofabrik.de/

paths.name: Database Storage
paths.description: PostgreSQL database storage. Requires significant disk space depending on region size.

paths.name: OSM Data (PBF Import)
paths.description: Path to your .osm.pbf file downloaded from Geofabrik. Only needed on first run (import mode).

paths.name: Custom Style
paths.description: Optional: Mount a custom CartoCSS/Mapnik style directory.

paths.name: Osmosis State (Live Updates)
paths.description: Required only if UPDATES is set to enabled.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for tile server and slippy map demo.

variables.name: Render Threads
variables.description: Number of threads used for rendering tiles. Match to your CPU core count.

variables.name: Live OSM Updates
variables.description: Set to [enabled] to keep the map updated via OSM diffs. Requires the Osmosis path to be set.

variables.name: Allow Cors
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable CORS headers (useful when embedding tiles in web apps).
